_doc: V4 = V3 (one-line description + bare parameter schema) for all 85 tools, PLUS a short clause kept IN THE DESCRIPTION for the tools where the 500-question run showed the text is load-bearing. Measured on the 61 destructive requests: reading the guide does NOT restore the two-phase protocol (V3 fetched the right guide in 46/61 cases and still previewed only 22% of the time, against 27% when it had not fetched it). Always-in-context text works; fetched text does not. So the protocol, cascade and deprecation clauses stay in the description and everything else goes.

descriptions.delete_metadata: Delete a metadata object or member (FQN-addressed). DESTRUCTIVE and CASCADING - removing an object also removes what references it. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview what will be removed, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.delete_project: Remove an EDT project from the workspace, optionally with its sources on disk. DESTRUCTIVE and IRREVERSIBLE. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.rename_metadata_object: Rename a metadata object or member and rewrite every reference to it. CASCADES ACROSS THE WHOLE CONFIGURATION - BSL, forms, roles, subsystems. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to see the edit scope, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.update_database: Apply the current EDT configuration to an infobase. DESTRUCTIVE - restructures data and can evict live sessions. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.delete_infobase: Remove a project's infobase or its standalone-server registration, optionally deleting the database files. DESTRUCTIVE and IRREVERSIBLE. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.delete_launch_config: Remove an unused EDT runtime or attach launch configuration. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to preview, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.terminate_launch: Stop 1C sessions started by EDT. Two-phase: call once WITHOUT confirm to see what would be stopped, then again with confirm=true to apply.
descriptions.resync_to_disk: Write the in-memory model back out to the on-disk src/ .mdo files and report model-to-disk desync; fixes 'object file does not exist' failures and dangling Configuration.mdo references. Direction MODEL -> DISK, the opposite of clean_project. Two opt-in modes are DESTRUCTIVE: re-exporting every object overwrites on-disk edits, and removing dangling references rewrites Configuration.mdo.
descriptions.clean_project: Rebuild an EDT project from the on-disk src/ files and revalidate everything. Direction DISK -> MODEL; slow, and it DISCARDS unsaved in-memory model edits - save first. For one externally-edited object prefer revalidate_objects; for the opposite direction see resync_to_disk.
descriptions.revalidate_objects: Revalidate a project or a named list of objects, picking up .mdo edits made outside EDT. Targeted, lightweight alternative to clean_project - no full rebuild, nothing discarded.
descriptions.debug_yaxunit_tests: DEPRECATED alias of run_yaxunit_tests(debug=true) - prefer that instead; behaviour is identical. Kept for compatibility.
descriptions.search_in_code: Literal/regex full-text search across BSL modules. Matching is textual and NOT ru/en dialect-aware, so a query in one BSL language will not find the other spelling - for a symbol's usages use find_references, for where it is defined use go_to_definition.

get_markers.markerKind: 'bookmark' = manual navigation bookmarks; 'task' = TODO/FIXME/XXX/HACK code markers. Omit for both.

get_project_errors.objects: Loose case-insensitive SUBSTRING match against the reported location; mutually exclusive with objectFqns.
get_project_errors.objectFqns: EXACT model addresses; mutually exclusive with objects. Returns objectsNotFound / objectsUnsupported.

get_method_call_hierarchy.direction: 'callers' = who calls this method, 'callees' = what it calls.

create_infobase.infobaseFile: Absolute path to the infobase directory. FILE infobases only - server/web are rejected.

run_yaxunit_tests.debug: true launches in DEBUG mode so breakpoints fire and returns a launch handle immediately - call wait_for_break next. Default false polls and returns the report.

write_module_source.expectedHash: Lost-update guard: the hash from the read that produced your edit. The write is rejected if the module changed since.
